notifications.title: Thank you for using Thingport
notifications.body: Thanks for using Thingport! From now on, major updates and new features will be announced here, in the System tab of your notifications.

notifications.title: Thingport 1.0.0 is out
notifications.body: The first stable release brings a remade administration panel, single sign-on providers, and many bug fixes and UI improvements. Update to get them.

entries.title: Welcome to Thingport 1.0.0
entries.body: Thanks for updating to the first stable release! Run a system health check in Administration to make sure everything is set up right. From now on, releases will come less often but pack more changes.
